visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens on a dark brown wooden door within a brightly lit indoor hallway. A man dressed in a camouflage shirt and a green tactical helmet enters the frame, looking disheveled with dark soot smudged across his cheeks. He gazes off to the side with a shocked, wide-eyed expression. (2) A second person with shoulder-length dark hair and a light-colored T-shirt enters the frame from the left, reaching out to grasp the soldier's shoulders. The setting is a minimalist indoor space with white walls and a glimpse of a wooden staircase in the background. (3) The scene shifts to a green-screen composite background. The man in camouflage is seen running towards the camera against a backdrop of massive explosions, fire, and billowing smoke. He holds his helmet with his hands as sparks fly past him. (4) The background transitions again to show a military helicopter hovering in a blue sky over a grassy ridge. The man looks up in terror, pointing his hand toward the sky while the camera follows his upward gaze. (5) Another background change displays a large green tank crashing through a city street. The man is positioned in the foreground, looking back at the tank with a scream of agony, reaching his hand out as if being crushed. (6) The video cuts back to the indoor hallway. The cross-dressed person is shown covering their face with their hands, weeping. The soldier then holds up a smartphone, pointing at the screen which displays a game menu interface. (7) A sequence of fast-paced gameplay footage follows, showing first-person shooting, armored vehicles driving through a desert, and massive explosions on a battlefield. (8) The soldier returns to the screen, now smiling and giving a thumbs-up to the camera in a brightly lit room. He points at the viewer with a confident gesture before the final game logo appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp metallic click of a door handle followed by the low-frequency creak of a door opening. A male voice enters with heavy, strained breathing and sobbing. A somber piano BGM plays at a slow tempo. (2) A second male voice (imitating a female tone) speaks softly with high pitch. The somber music continues as the primary male voice starts a dramatic monologue with fractured pauses. (3) A loud 'boom' SFX occurs, triggering a shift to high-arousal audio. Multiple rapid-fire impact sounds and a high-pitched 'whizzing' sound represent bullets. A helicopter's low-frequency rhythmic 'thud-thud' blades are heard. (4) A massive explosion sound with broadband noise is followed by a loud splash SFX. The BGM shifts to a more neutral, inquisitive tone. (5) A sudden 'whoosh' transition leads into high-tempo electronic Phonk-style music with heavy synth bass. The male voice becomes very energetic, shouting with professional broadcasting clarity and high arousal. (6) Rapid-fire gunshots (percussive transients) and explosion SFX occur frequently in sync with the high-tempo BGM. The speaker's volume increases as he delivers promotional slogans.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Storytelling -> Transition -> Product Reveal -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, exaggerated skit about a traumatized soldier returning home to capture audience attention, then subverts expectations by revealing that his 'battle' was actually gameplay in the mobile game 'Garena Delta Force' (三角洲行動). The purpose is to promote the game's high quality, 24vs24 mode, and free-to-play nature.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the game name, logo, gameplay footage, and a call to action to play the game.
